ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms trace propagation, a sampling policy and the sensitive-payload flag are declared; it does not show traces are collected.
offer: Propagate trace context across HTTP and asynchronous boundaries and bound sampling costs. Sensitive request bodies must not become trace attributes.

minimal.reason: Declare how trace context propagates across HTTP and async hops. Broken propagation splits a request into orphan traces, so state the headers or carriers.

mid.reason: Declare the sampling policy. Unbounded sampling costs money and storage, so set a rate or rule.

maximal.reason: Set recording sensitive payloads to false. Request bodies as trace attributes leak data, so record identifiers only.
